hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler lending vaults. beforeSwap handles each swap entirely: computing amounts via EulerSwap's bespoke curve, depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, and returning the full BeforeSwapDelta to the pool manager. Standard liquidity operations and donations are blocked.
